name: EnchanteX
source:
EnchanteX is an urban-fantasy chat-sim with visual-novel elements. Play as a Wizard, Witch or Wix, pick your name, icon and hobbies, help customers in need, and, of course, learn more about the Trio... And the thing connecting them.

[From [URL=https://urararar.itch.io/enchantex]Itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
EnchanteX是一款带有视觉小说元素的都市奇幻聊天模拟游戏。扮演巫师、女巫或维克斯，选择你的名字、图标和爱好，帮助有需要的客户，当然，还可以了解有关Trio的更多信息……以及连接他们的事物。

[来自 [URL=https://urararar.itch.io/enchantex]Itch.io[/URL]]
